- Technology-driven processes used to improve operational efficiency, inventory management, customer engagement and supply chain visibility

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Management states the sector is subject to extensive regulation and that changes in government policies, pricing controls, licensing requirements and compliance obligations may impact business operations.
- The Company operates in a highly competitive market with numerous regional and national participants; management says maintaining customer relationships and service quality remains critical.
- Management flags disruptions in supply chains, transportation challenges, vendor dependency and fluctuations in logistics costs as risks to operational performance.
- Realised, not hypothetical: despite ~25% revenue growth, FY26 PBT and PAT both fell, which management attributed to increased logistics and transportation costs, higher operational and employee-related expenses, listing and compliance costs, and competitive market conditions.
- Changes in macroeconomic conditions, inflationary pressures, interest rates and consumer spending patterns may influence business growth.
- Increasing reliance on digital systems for a technology-driven distribution model requires continuous focus on information security, data protection and system reliability.
- The Secretarial Auditor raised observations on Structured Digital Database maintenance, cost records and overseas investment filing; the Company did not adequately maintain the cost records prescribed under the Companies (Cost Records and Audit) Rules, 2014, and had not filed Form FC with the AD Banker for the US subsidiary under the FEMA Overseas Investment Rules, 2022, with Late Submission Fees now payable.
- Earkart Inc. was incorporated on 20 January 2026 but remained non-operational at 31 March 2026 with nil share capital, assets and turnover per Form AOC-1, so the stated international growth avenue is at present a platform only and has already produced a FEMA filing lapse.
